summary: Develop practical ISO 45001-aligned safety system skills, risk controls, and KPI reporting. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Safety management system training helps safety officers, HSE specialists, and operations managers organise workplace risks into documented controls and accountable actions. It covers ISO 45001 and the Plan-Do-Check-Act cycle, with practice in hazard identification, risk assessment, control selection, Bowtie analysis, and incident investigation. Learners also develop corrective-action records and use audit evidence and KPI dashboards to review and communicate safety performance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who contribute directly to workplace health and safety systems, from hazard controls and incident follow-up to operational oversight and leadership reporting. This course is designed for: HSE Officers maintaining hazard registers and tracking workplace controls. Safety Coordinators organising inspections, incident reports, and corrective actions. Occupational Health and Safety Specialists reviewing risk assessments and control effectiveness. Safety Management System Auditors checking documented processes against ISO 45001. Operations Managers integrating safety controls into daily production and service work. Construction Safety Managers coordinating contractor controls and high-risk work permits. Manufacturing Supervisors monitoring machine risks and work-area safety actions. Incident Investigators analysing events and documenting corrective-action evidence. Occupational Health Professionals contributing health-risk controls and worker consultation. Safety and Risk Directors reporting system performance and implementation priorities.
modules: 5 Whys Incident Investigation and Corrective Actions
prerequisites: Working knowledge of workplace operations or basic occupational health and safety practices is recommended. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel if you want to complete the optional spreadsheet-based KPI exercise.
